result.reason: The operative language does not reach the playbook position. It provides a 12-month documentation-conformance warranty for both Software and MarketSite.net Service, rather than separately covering software for 12 months and services for 90 days, and it omits warranties that services will be performed professionally and workmanlike and that performance will comply with laws. The malicious-code warranty is also limited to willfully introduced code. Although correction, replacement, and a conditional refund are included, the refund is tied to termination and only covers prepaid fees. Applying the 12-month period to the service goes beyond the requested service duration, so the revision is not fully minimal. The margin comment cannot cure these operative omissions.
